{{Top|leg}}
'''Breath of the Dragon''' was an aspect of [[Zakuul]]an mythology that predated the [[Old Ways (Zakuul)|Old Ways]]. The Dragon [[Zildrog]] would test the strength of a warrior's spirit, consuming the fallen and bestowing the Breath of the Dragon to those who emerged victorious. The act imbued a soul with burning fire, bringing him fortune in the future.<ref name="KOTET">{{TORcite|type=codex|Heralds of Zildrog}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Breath of the Dragon is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' in a codex entry obtained during '''Chapter 7: The Lady of Sorrows'''.
